Private Function Dumped(ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    If Application.WorksheetFunction.CountA(ws.Cells) = 0 Then Exit Function
    For Each c In ws.UsedRange.Cells
        If Not IsEmpty(c.Value) Then s = s & c.Address(False, False) & "=" & TypeName(c.Value) & ":" & c.Text & ";"
    Next
    Dumped = s
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, s As String, v As String, r As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which \ 80
    Case 0: Act0 which, folder, ws, r
    Case 1: Act1 which, folder, ws, r
    Case 2: Act2 which, folder, ws, r
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = ws.QueryTables.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = Dumped(ws)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
